title: Dual-Device (Personal + Corporate) Management with Single Sign-On in Microsoft Intune
author_notes: The solution must allow a single user account to sign in on both the COD and BYOD device for scenarios where a user has 2 devices, a Personal and Corporate Owned device.

Forked (+1) from cod-and-byod-device-management v1.0.0: a separate product specializing in the one-user/two-physical-devices scenario with single sign-on across both. The original COD/BYOD product is unchanged.
